name: ai-chatbot
setup: . scripts/env.sh && cd "$SRC" && rm -rf node_modules && HUSKY=0 npm_config_store_dir="$RM/.tools/pnpm-store" npm_config_cache_dir="$RM/.tools/pnpm-cache" npm_config_state_dir="$RM/.tools/pnpm-state" npm_config_manage_package_manager_versions=false "$RM/.tools/pm/node_modules/.bin/pnpm" install --frozen-lockfile
. scripts/env.sh && cd "$SRC" && { test -f next-env.d.ts || printf '/// <reference types="next" />\n/// <reference types="next/image-types/global" />\n' > next-env.d.ts; }
notes: Env: commands assume $RM (router-migrate root) and $SRC (working copy) are exported and scripts/env.sh is sourced (setup does this itself); run every step under `env -u RAMP_ROUTER_API_KEY`. Node v24.19.0, npm 11.17.0, local pnpm 10.34.7, yarn berry from the repo. Setup writes the standard gitignored next-env.d.ts (`next dev`/`next build` would create it). Without it, tsc reports spurious missing-declaration errors for .png/.css imports. The real tests are Playwright e2e (pnpm test), which need `pnpm dev` + Postgres + Redis + Blob, so they cannot run offline here. test_cmd is a TypeScript typecheck (TS 5.8.2, 154 project files, --incremental false). Baseline: 0 errors. The repo has no typecheck script; `check` = ultracite (biome lint), not used. packageManager pins pnpm@10.32.1 and the local pnpm 10.34.7 is used (lockfile v9, frozen install OK). IMPORTANT: npm_config_manage_package_manager_versions=false (in setup) is REQUIRED; otherwise any pnpm command in this repo tries to download pnpm 10.32.1 into ~/Library/pnpm/.tools (that happened once during this work, failed half-way, and the partial dir was removed). For the same reason test/typecheck call ./node_modules/.bin/tsc directly, not `pnpm exec`. pnpm store/cache/state are redirected under $RM/.tools. HUSKY=0 skips git hook install. pnpm 10 ignored the build scripts of bufferutil/esbuild/sharp; tsc does not need them. Cold-cache install took 32s. 2 runs: identical.
